title: Family Sitting on Living Room Sofa, 1958 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot stamped MAY 58 along the bottom border, capturing a family relaxed on a sectional sofa in a mid-century home interior. A woman and man sit side by side while a teenage boy in a plaid shirt and jeans recline on the right armrest. In the foreground, a low coffee table holds ashtrays and a small vase with a flower, reflecting typical 1950s domestic life in suburban America.
